results.name: independently known paint arithmetic and exact displayed precision
different-domain recipe scaling uses the same explicit engine
invalid/blank/whole-number/range inputs report their field without mutation
divide-by-zero and overflow are recoverable calculation errors
code strings, prototype names, unknown variables and oversized trees are refused
a fresh store makes no false save claim; write/readback and reload succeed
corrupt and future-version storage stays untouched while session work continues
read denial never leads to an overwrite attempt
write failure retains session state and a retry succeeds when safe
a completed write with failed readback reconciles without a duplicate write
an ambiguous write never overwrites different competing data on retry
an external deletion after an ambiguous write is never recreated by retry
a clear event invalidates saved status without reacting to another storage area
detected competing save is preserved rather than overwritten
invalid app data is refused without changing the prior data or save
unchanged save status does not repeatedly mutate a live region
scaffolder generates local linked files and a valid arithmetic contract
existing destinations and executable formula strings cannot replace files
untrusted label text remains data in generated JavaScript

limits: Pure arithmetic/state/generation checks only; no browser was opened.
Keyboard, focus, layout, screen-reader and participant behaviour remain unverified.
